_note: Editorial scores for the demo market xx (fictional). Each criterion 0-10 with a one-line reason; the overall score is computed from the blueprint weights. Bonuses are scored here because the demo market allows promotions. Every review needs at least one con. Sportsbooks also carry odds, markets and live_bet scores; "products" holds the review text for sports-only and casino + sport sites (casino-review product switcher).

marlowe.summary: The most complete all-rounder: strong live tables, phone support and fair bonus terms.
marlowe.verdict: Marlowe Club does everything well and nothing badly. Card withdrawals took about four hours in our tests, slower than Nyxa's Apple Pay payouts.

safety.reason: Licence shown in the footer; deposit limits offered at sign-up.

payouts.reason: Card withdrawals arrived in 3 to 5 hours across five tests.

games.reason: About 2,600 games with a good mix of large and small studios.

live.reason: 130 live tables, including low-stake roulette all night.

app.reason: Stable app on iOS and Android; game search could be faster.

support.reason: 24h chat plus a phone line that answered in under a minute.

bonuses.reason: Welcome offer with 1× wagering on the bonus, terms on one page.

pros: Low 1× wagering on the welcome offer

nyxa.summary: Fastest payouts we measured and a big slot library; live casino is thin.
nyxa.verdict: Nyxa pays fastest: Apple Pay withdrawals landed in about a quarter of an hour. Its live casino is small and there is no phone support.

safety.reason: Licence displayed; identity check before the first withdrawal only.

payouts.reason: Apple Pay withdrawals in 10 to 20 minutes, cards in about 2 hours.

games.reason: About 3,300 games with clear filters and RTP shown.

live.reason: 70 live tables, few open late at night.

app.reason: Quick app with deposit and limits two taps away.

support.reason: 24h chat replied in 3 minutes; no phone line.

bonuses.reason: Generous welcome offer but 30× wagering on bonus funds.

odds.reason: Around 5% margin on top football, higher on tennis.

markets.reason: About 900 markets on a big match, with player stats.

live_bet.reason: About 2,600 live events a day; bets accepted in a couple of seconds.

sports.summary: Fast payouts and a strong football book; tennis margins are above average.
sports.verdict: Nyxa suits football bettors who want their winnings fast: Apple Pay withdrawals took about 15 minutes. Tennis odds are worse than at Vantro.

both.summary: Casino and betting in one wallet, the fastest payouts; a small live casino.
both.verdict: Nyxa pairs a big slot library with a solid football book and paid out fastest in our tests. The live casino is modest and tennis margins are above average.
pros: One balance for casino and bets

verazul.summary: Strong live casino and quick card payouts, smaller slot library.
verazul.verdict: Verazul pairs 150 live tables with card withdrawals in about 90 minutes. Chat closes at midnight and the slot range is narrower.

safety.reason: Licence displayed; clear terms, but verification took a day.

app.reason: Full-featured app; too many notifications by default.

support.reason: Chat from 8:00 to midnight; phone line available.

bonuses.reason: Cashback on live losses with no wagering, small welcome offer.

odds.reason: Around 6% margin, the priciest in the list.

markets.reason: About 450 markets per match, few player bets.

live_bet.reason: About 900 live events a day, almost no streams.

sports.summary: A sportsbook added to a live casino: few markets and a high margin.
sports.verdict: Betting at Verazul is an add-on to the casino: about 450 markets per match and a margin around 6%. Bettors are better off with Vantro or Nyxa, but card withdrawals are quick.

both.summary: One of the best live casinos; betting is there, but the book is thin.
both.verdict: Choose Verazul for the live casino: 150 tables and fast card withdrawals. The sportsbook is thin and its margin is higher than the rest of the list.

lunaro.summary: The biggest live casino in the list; few slots and short support hours.
lunaro.verdict: Lunaro is built for live players: 220 tables, many open around the clock. Slot fans have better options, and support closes at 21:00.

safety.reason: Licence displayed; limit tools easy to find.

live.reason: 220 live tables, the largest selection we tested.

app.reason: Light app; live streams stayed smooth on 4G.

support.reason: Chat 9:00 to 21:00; email answered in two days.

bonuses.reason: Live-only welcome offer; slots do not count toward wagering.

cobaltio.summary: Largest game library, but slow bank-only payouts and no app.
cobaltio.verdict: Cobaltio has the biggest catalogue here, over 4,500 games. Withdrawals go by bank transfer only and took two days; there is no app.

safety.reason: Licence displayed; responsible-gambling page is incomplete.

payouts.reason: Bank withdrawals only, about 48 hours each time.

games.reason: Over 4,500 games, the largest selection we tested.

app.reason: No app; the mobile site works but loads slowly.

support.reason: 24h chat answered quickly and knew the terms.

bonuses.reason: Weekly free spins with no wagering on winnings.

odds.reason: Around 5.6% margin, noticeably lower on ice hockey.

markets.reason: About 700 markets per match, good esports coverage.

live_bet.reason: About 1,800 live events a day and streams of major leagues.

sports.summary: Streams of major leagues and strong esports, but withdrawals take two days.
sports.verdict: Cobaltio streams major leagues and covers esports well. The catch is the same as its casino: bank-only withdrawals of about two days and no app.

both.summary: A huge game catalogue and good live betting; slow withdrawals and no app.
both.verdict: Cobaltio is for players who want lots of slots and streamed live betting in one place. Bank-only withdrawals take about two days and there is no app.

vantro.summary: The best odds and the widest book we tested; no casino.
vantro.verdict: Vantro is the sportsbook for bettors who compare odds: a margin around 4% and up to 1,400 markets per match. There is no casino and the welcome offer is small.

safety.reason: Licence in plain sight; bet limits set in two steps.

payouts.reason: Card withdrawals in about an hour, bank transfers up to 12 hours.

odds.reason: Around 4% margin on football and tennis, the best we tested.

markets.reason: Up to 1,400 markets on a big match, 38 sports.

live_bet.reason: About 4,200 live events a day; cash-out works in play.

app.reason: Fast app, one tap to bet in play.

support.reason: Chat and phone 24/7; chat answered within a minute.

bonuses.reason: The first-bet free bet is small, with fair terms.

cons: Bank withdrawals take up to 12 hours
